documents.text: Employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual vacation leave and 10 days of paid sick leave annually. Unused vacation days carry forward up to a maximum of 5 days into the following year.
The company work from home policy allows team members to work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10 AM to 4 PM.
Standard notice period during voluntary resignation is 30 calendar days for regular software engineers. During probation, the notice period is 15 calendar days.
Business travel expenses for domestic flights and hotel bookings up to 150 dollars per night will be reimbursed by corporate finance upon submission of original receipts within 14 days.
Employees must change their corporate account passwords every 90 days and enable multi-factor authentication on all devices. Sharing credentials is a severe violation.
Annual performance bonuses are distributed in March and evaluated based on individual key performance indicators and company overall financial targets.
Comprehensive health insurance covers employees and their dependents up to five hundred thousand rupees per year, including cashless hospitalization at network hospitals.
Every new engineer receives an Apple MacBook Pro M3 with 32GB RAM and an external 4K monitor for development work.
The standard probation period for new hires is three months, after which a formal confirmation performance review is conducted by the department head.
Upon resignation, all company property including laptop, security badge, and building access tokens must be surrendered to IT operations on the last working day.
Overtime compensation is paid at 1.5 times the standard hourly rate for approved project hours worked beyond 40 hours in a single calendar week.
The code of conduct strictly prohibits harassment, discrimination, and unauthorized disclosure of confidential client intellectual property.
